reviewed_by: Claude general-purpose subagent, blind judgment reviewer, wide-packet re-review batch 4, 2026-08-01

samples_reviewed.question_text: In 135, what digit is in the ones place?
What place is the digit 1 in, in the number 195?
What is the place value of the digit 3 in 320?
What is the place value of the digit 8 in 285?
What place is the digit 0 in, in the number 260?
What number do the blocks show?
What place is the digit 5 in, in the number 520? The answer is hundreds.. True or False?
Use base-10 blocks to show the number 165.

competency_fulfillment.rationale: All three named sub-cases appear and check out: digit-given-place (seed 42, '135' ones digit is 5), place-name-given-digit (seed 43, digit 1 in 195 is hundreds), and numeric value-of-digit (seed 44, digit 3 in 320 has value 300).

comprehensive_coverage.rationale: Coverage spans place-naming (43, 46, 51), numeric value (44, 45), digit-given-place (42), and concrete base-10-block representation (50, 88) -- all sub-cases the competency's wording implies are represented across the 8 seeds.

cognitive_capacity.rationale: 3-digit numbers (135-610) with single-step place-value lookups, e.g. 'What is the place value of the digit 8 in 285?', match grade 2 quarter 1 demand for the newly-introduced hundreds place.

variant_comprehensiveness.rationale: Format variety is genuine: mcq, cloze, true_false, read_mcq (visual blocks in seed 50), and set_fill_in_blank (constructive blocks task in seed 88) all appear, giving both abstract and concrete-model framings.

competency_alignment.rationale: Every sample targets place-value identification or construction directly, e.g. 'Use base-10 blocks to show the number 165' (seed 88) builds the same skill the competency names rather than drifting into arithmetic.

scale_appropriateness.rationale: All numbers used (135 to 610) are 3-digit values as the competency specifies ('a digit in a 3-digit number'), correctly scoped rather than reaching for 4-digit or larger values.
